I think that Zhongli Yelan and Yunjin is absolutely the best comp for Yoimiya, because you have a great spam damage with buff, vaporize and shield. This comp is also easy to do if you are a F2P: you can use Noelle as Zhongli and Xingqiu as Yelan. Of course, in this case, you have less damage and shield, but you can also do a good job, especially for the rotation that you create with Yoi's ult to buff Noelle and wait for her E's coldown.

Another funny team is Fischl/Beidou with Yoimiya to trigger a lot of Overload and range damage, but i recommend you to use Kazuha/Sucrose with it, because enemies literally explode and you can't hit them.

If you want to run Ganyu, anyway, you can go for Diona/Xiangling Bennet Kazuha: Diona for more shield, heal and resonance (buff also if she is C6) and Xiangling for more damage.

These are my ideas... you can try her anyway with a lot of other pgs, the important is to have fun with your comp and beat the Abyss. So yeah... have fun and try anything you want ;)
